bio: Taking its cue from the seasons and made with select ingredients, the food here is meticulously prepared, flavoursome and fresh – it is clear that chef Steve Eulenstein has worked at some top-flight establishments in his time. He proposes two set menus as well as classics such as rump steak. The dining space is attractive and minimalist in style, and the service is friendly and professional. The location in a residential area just a few minutes' drive from the BAB 3 motorway is also convenient....
